policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The #369 body-observer ownership fix adds one instrumented and covered client/core line so stale handles compare their exact subscriber identity before cleanup, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2326/2666 (87.247%) to 2327/2667 (87.252%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 1788 tests across 233 files and reproduced exactly 2327/2667. Retaining the existing one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2326/2667 (87.214%), stricter than the prior 2325/2666 tolerated floor (87.209%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The #453 injected-shell HTTP fix preserves Jellyfin compression, adds transformed-representation validators and a bounded warm cache, with behavioral coverage for real response-compression ordering, identity/gzip/Brotli bodies, ETag and Last-Modified 304s, source revalidation, and script-generation invalidation. The third and fourth of four clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 2,287 tests and reproduced exactly 27,188/35,896 instrumented lines (75.741%), so the reviewed high-water advances from 26,991/35,680 (75.647%). Retaining the existing evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 27,183/35,896 (75.727%), stricter than the prior 26,986/35,680 floor (75.633%); the other two clean runs measured 27,184 and 27,189 covered lines within that window. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
